description: SL-O: adds another set of eight outputs to a Solim chain, carrying the results of the SL-I input expander paired with it; it goes to the right of the Solim module

outputs.text: A limited and sorted voltage from the SL-I expander paired with this one; the results fill the outputs from the first one down

notes: this expander is placed to the right of the Solim module; up to seven of them can be chained, and the lamp at the top turns green when the chain reaches this one
expanders pair up from the Solim module outwards, so the nearest SL-O carries the values of the nearest SL-I
the small green lamp beside an output lights while a value is being sent to it
menu: Polyphonic output — sends all the results down the first output as channels and leaves the other seven at 0V
